scope: Current-release development replications; not general enterprise efficacy evidence
treatment: Luna xhigh, published native MCP, bundled skill, agent-authored SQL/card and live Jev policy judgments
control: Same Luna, 27 Superset analytical tools, owner policy, workspace, SQL/code and automation abilities, without SignalWeave
setup_boundary: Actual isolated terminal wizard, Codex registration and skill after research-helper archive extraction/copy; not a new public-curl-installer or real-human novice study
operator_boundary: The isolated actor uses a research-only operator callback to forward its own query file to the real native query-import CLI. This substitutes for the host terminal access an ordinary Codex user would grant; it supplies no analytical SQL or card. It is not an extra public MCP tool.

northstar.source: Real local Superset over the finalized synthetic warehouse, not an as-known-at-the-time backtest
northstar.unit: Two repetitions of the same seven-period company task, four trajectories; periods are not independent enterprises
northstar.routine_delivery: Dispatch digest every period, including ignore; separate Data Operations handoff for the missing dates

original_pair.status: Closed research-quota-censored diagnostic; original records not rescored
original_pair.reader_result: Both sets' core figures/routes supported; treatment messages longer. Three later native checks were blocked by the nine-request research ceiling, not Jev. No clean reliability or efficiency comparison.

fresh_pair.status: Both trajectories closed and independently reviewed; no research-provider rejection
fresh_pair.reader_method: Independent Luna reviewer prepared rubric before original label-C/D inbox packets; knew source oracle, not traces, mapping or timing. Unedited tooling clues make blinding partial.
reader_findings: Both delivered seven digests, the qualifying investigation and missing-date handoff; no core claim contradicted the oracle.
The SignalWeave run supplied a copy-verified 12-record damage worklist matching every oracle ID and an explicit follow-up; baseline supplied neither worklist nor attachments.
Both sent unnecessary monitoring-metadata questions to Data Operations. SignalWeave also sent evaluation-process commentary to Dispatch, an audience mismatch.

The oracle supports trigger-worklist IDs, but did not verify supplemental daily distributions, late rates, delivery-time averages or service/region/date attributes. Supporting copies do not establish recipient opens.
fresh_pair.query_accounting: Independent read-only SQLLab metadata matches all captured query IDs: baseline 25, treatment 20 (12 direct plus eight native reads). Original pair was baseline 12 versus treatment 17. Counts do not measure scanned bytes or warehouse cost.
fresh_pair.conclusion: Reviewed-card recurrence and a useful investigation handoff work in this known scenario. Treatment took 18.2% longer and more uncached frontier tokens; no speed/cost, fewer-message, general superiority or Jev-specific causal benefit is established.

harbor.status: Baseline onboarding stages closed; independently admitted 28-day recurrence in progress. Treatment not admitted.
harbor.source: Company MCP over isolated synthetic SQLite event-history snapshots, not a vendor-cloud connector
harbor.people: Five model-simulated company roles, not real humans
harbor.readiness_limit: The saved baseline query does not establish event completeness; whole-week rates are withheld. The weekly threshold branch is unproven.
harbor.quiet_state_limit: Every daily cutoff has qualifying work; this cohort cannot establish quiet-day suppression.

proof_boundaries: Adaptive repetitions on known history are not independent holdouts or statistical significance.
This whole-stack comparison does not isolate Jev from the skill, card context, retrieval or frontier behavior.
Deliveries are simulated local inboxes, not Slack/email or proof that a human read or acted.
Billing cost is unknown; tokens and SQL counts are not monetary savings.
All 208 copied runtime files matched rc5 in a separate post-setup check; these studies did not prospectively freeze the runtime inventory.
Raw traces remain in ignored artifacts/workflow-proof-2026-10-20. Hashes alone are not public reproduction of those private records.
The new-company quiet/ambiguity transfer stage is not admitted or executed. Enterprise readiness is not established.
